description: This file defines API endpoints for the submissions feature of a data insights dashboard backend. It includes routes to create, retrieve, validate, and approve/reject data product submissions, integrating authentication, validation, and approval services.

methods.name: CreateSubmissionResponse create_submission( user=Security(get_current_user_dep), request: CreateSubmissionRequest = None, )
methods.description: Creates a new submission from a draft and triggers validation, performing user authorization checks.

methods.name: GetSubmissionResponse get_submission( submission_id: str, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific submission by ID, including validation status.

methods.name: TriggerValidationResponse trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Triggers validation run for a specific submission, initiating quality checks.

methods.name: ApproveSubmissionResponse approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Handles approval or rejection of a submission with support for electronic signatures and SoD validation.

ctags.name: approve_submission
ctags.signature: ( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )

ctags.signature: ( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
